sections.heading: CloneInToNewWorld_Patch
sections.title: CloneInToNewWorld_Patch
sections.description: The core patch, a postfix on `SettingsCache.CloneInToNewWorld`. `Apply` loads the options, calls `Plan` for every subworld, writes the resulting band tables into `MutatedWorldData.biomes.BiomeBackgroundElementBandConfigurations` and sets each chosen `SubWorld.backwallNoise`. Any exception is caught and logged and worldgen continues untouched. `Plan` decides without changing anything and is reused by the YAML export.

sections.heading: Options
sections.title: Options
sections.description: The mod's settings, a PLib `IOptions` class stored in the shared config location and read again for each world generated, so changes need no restart.

sections.heading: BiomeGroup and BiomeGroups
sections.title: BiomeGroup and BiomeGroups
sections.description: A family of worldgen biome files sharing one material and coverage setting (Sandstone, Forest, Frozen, Caustic, Marsh, Ocean, Oil, Rust, Magma, Barren; Swamp, Wasteland, Metallic, Moo, Radioactive, Aquatic for Spaced Out; CarrotQuarry, IceCaves, SugarWoods for Frosty Planet; Garden, Raptor, Wetlands for Prehistoric Planet; Beach, Reef, KelpForest, Abyss for Aquatic Planet Pack).

sections.heading: Pattern, PatternGroup and Patterns
sections.title: Pattern, PatternGroup and Patterns
sections.description: A `Pattern` is a noise tree (Reef, Kelp, Abyss, Beach under `noise/NaturalBackwalls*`, plus the base-game `Strange`, plus `Vanilla` meaning the subworld's own tree). A `PatternGroup` is a subworld zone type (`SubWorld.ZoneType`) with a default pattern: Kelp for ToxicJungle, BoggyMarsh, Swamp, SugarWoods, PrehistoricGarden, PrehistoricWetlands; Abyss for OilField, Rust, MagmaCore, Barren, Wasteland, Metallic, Radioactive; Reef elsewhere; the Aquatic pack's own zones default to Vanilla.

sections.heading: Options entries
sections.title: Options entries
sections.description: Custom PLib option rows: `BiomeOptionsEntry` (material dropdown plus coverage text box per biome group) and `PatternOptionsEntry` (pattern dropdown showing each tree's density per zone).

sections.heading: Worldgen noise trees
sections.title: Worldgen noise trees
sections.description: Four YAML noise trees shipped with the mod (`NaturalBackwallsReef`, `Kelp`, `Abyss`, `Beach`). `mod.yaml` and the worldgen folder are deployed with the mod.

sections.heading: ExportOverlay
sections.title: ExportOverlay
sections.description: Writes the current settings as a mod-style worldgen YAML folder, `NaturalBackwalls-overlay` in the game's root folder (`Util.RootFolder()`), for external renderers and the preview tool. Reuses `Plan`.

sections.heading: BiomePreview tool
sections.title: BiomePreview tool
sections.description: A .NET 8 Windows tool that runs the game's noise trees and band tables for one biome and writes an HTML preview. Not part of the mod DLL.
